script:
$env:Path = [System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("Path","Machine") + ";" + [System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("Path","User")
$configDir = "$env:USERPROFILE\.config\opencode"
cd $configDir
Remove-Item -Recurse -Force node_modules -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Remove-Item package-lock.json -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Remove-Item package.json -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
npm init -y 2>&1 | Out-Null
"=== force install ==="
npm install --force opencode-vibeguard opencode-shell-strategy 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 15
"=== verify ==="
if (Test-Path "node_modules") { Get-ChildItem node_modules -Directory | Select-Object Name } else { "STILL MISSING" }
